title: Map incident playbook actions to testable PRD scenarios and telemetry contracts
creator: Priya Patel
description: Translate specific postmortem actions from the KV-cache/coldstart incident into concrete, testable PRD requirements: define operational safety budgets, telemetry contracts, and acceptance criteria that gate rollouts. Deliverable: a PRD appendix with mapped runbook -> PRD entries and a verification matrix that engineering and SRE can use to certify releases.
background: During the 2026-01-05 KV-cache stall incident (postmortem INC-2026-011), several runbook actions were identified (cache priming, progressive eviction thresholds, emergency regen circuit). Those items are currently operational runbook notes; we must encode them into the PRD so product, eng, and SRE share a single source of truth for rollouts and post-incident mitigation. Existing PRDs lack testable telemetry thresholds and explicit rollback gates tied to incidents.
decisions: Scope will be limited to serving runtime and cache-related mitigations for initial rollout; storage and networking incident mappings will be handled in a follow-up ticket
Acceptance criteria will be binary/pass-fail where possible (synthetic checks pass) and numeric for SLOs (tail latency, cache hit-rate targets)
Telemetry contracts will be specified as metric names, aggregation window, alert thresholds, and required dashboard panels; engineering to own metric instrumentation, PM to own thresholds

Rollout gating: canary progression requires 6h steady-state on synthetic verification and no SLO regressions beyond defined budget; temporary automatic rollback on severe SLO breach (>5% error-rate increase sustained 15m)
tasks: Draft PRD appendix mapping each postmortem action to a verifiable acceptance test
Work with ENG to define metric names and tags (e.g., runtime.kv_cache.evictions_per_min, runtime.request.tail_p99_ms)
Prototype synthetic tests that exercise cache priming and coldstart paths
Define rollout gating logic and add to Release Runbook section
Add examples and verification checklist to PRD for Solutions and Sales teams
acceptance_criteria: PRD appendix exists and lists each postmortem action with: purpose, owner, automated test, telemetry metric, and rollback criterion
At least 3 synthetic checks implemented in test harness verifying cache priming, KV-cache regen, and gradual eviction under load
Telemetry contracts documented: metric names, aggregation window (1m/5m), alert thresholds, and dashboard panels for each critical metric
Canary gating criteria documented and validated in a dry-run with staging traffic (6h baseline, no SLO degradation >1% for p95, no error-rate spike >2%)
One engineering PR references the PRD appendix and implements at least two telemetry metrics with dashboards and alerts
SRE review completed and sign-off captured in PRD comments
